# GENERATED — do not edit files in this directory

Everything here is produced by `scripts/sync-parts-data.mjs` from
[bw-parts](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/bw-parts). To update:

    node scripts/sync-parts-data.mjs

Do not patch files locally — a local fix becomes a third copy, and
the next sync overwrites it. Fix the source in bw-parts instead.

## Contents

- `*.json` — part sidecar data (terminals, dimensions)
- `*.svg` — part art (drawings for palette and canvas)
- `index.js` — generated static imports for bundler consumption
- `ART-PROVENANCE.md` — drawing methodology and sources (from bw-parts)
- `THIRD-PARTY.md` — licensing (from bw-parts)
